Since p2 is sitting on Vermont and will likely next land on magenta or orange spaces, building up those color groups toward hotels seems like the priority.

I'm leaning toward putting 4 houses on each magenta property first ($1200 total), leaving $570 as a buffer against p2's railroads and their Med/Baltic hotel rents, rather than stretching all the way to hotels right now.
